crossRefs.note: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and…
so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give…
“You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t…
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…

translations.web: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.
translations.bsb: Surely extortion turns a wise man into a fool, and a bribe corrupts the heart.
translations.kjv: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
translations.asv: Surely extortion maketh the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroyeth the understanding.
